content.text:
## Assessment verified

The failure chain, confirmed in source:

1. **Factory requires the field** — `extensions/factory/src/workflow.ts` (`IMPL_SCHEMA`, worker prompts) mandates `workLeftUndone` (and `decisionsRequiringApproval`) in the worker's handoff, with `WORKER_ACCEPTANCE = { level: "checked", ... }`.
2. **pi-subagents rejects it** — the `structured_output` tool takes *two* objects: `value` (validated against the factory schema, which allows `workLeftUndone`) and `acceptanceReport` (validated by pi-subagents itself). In `subagent-prompt-runtime.js:605` → `validateAcceptanceReport` → `normalizeAcceptanceReportValue` (`src/runs/shared/acceptance.js:690`), any key not in `ACCEPTANCE_REPORT_FIELDS` (line 586 — `criteriaSatisfied, changedFiles, testsAddedOrUpdated, commandsRun, validationOutput, residualRisks, noStagedFiles, diffSummary, reviewFindings, manualNotes`) throws:
   `Invalid structured output acceptance report: acceptanceReport.workLeftUndone: unsupported acceptance report field` — the child dies at the acceptance handoff.

Two more traps in the same field set: `decisionsRequiringApproval` is also unsupported, and the acceptance report's `commandsRun` entries need `{command, result: "passed"|"failed"|"not-run", summary}` — not the `{command, exitCode}` shape the value schema wants. The fix belongs in the factory's worker prompts (pi-subagents is a pinned dependency), teaching the two-channel contract:

edits.newText:
/**
 * Fields pi-subagents accepts inside a structured_output "acceptanceReport"
 * (pi-subagents src/runs/shared/acceptance.js ACCEPTANCE_REPORT_FIELDS). Any
 * other field — notably workLeftUndone and decisionsRequiringApproval — is
 * rejected with "unsupported acceptance report field", which fails the worker
 * at the acceptance handoff. Keep in sync with the installed pi-subagents.
 */
const ACCEPTANCE_REPORT_ALLOWED_FIELDS = [
	"changedFiles",
	"testsAddedOrUpdated",
	"commandsRun",
	"residualRisks",
	"validationOutput",
	"noStagedFiles",
	"diffSummary",
	"reviewFindings",
	"manualNotes",
] as const;

/**
 * Shared two-channel reporting rules for the implement and fix workers.
 * structured_output carries a "value" (validated against the factory handoff
 * schema) and an "acceptanceReport" (validated against pi-subagents' fixed
 * field set). Conflating the two fails the run at the acceptance handoff.
 */
const WORKER_REPORT_RULES = [
	`- Finish with the structured_output tool. Its "value" must match the handoff\nschema exactly: changedFiles, implementationSummary, commandsRun (each\n{command, exitCode}), testsAddedOrUpdated, residualRisks, workLeftUndone,\ndecisionsRequiringApproval.`,
	`- Its "acceptanceReport" must contain ONLY these fields:\n${ACCEPTANCE_REPORT_ALLOWED_FIELDS.join(", ")}. Acceptance-report commandsRun\nentries use {command, result: "passed" | "failed" | "not-run", summary} —\nnever exitCode. NEVER put workLeftUndone or decisionsRequiringApproval in\nthe acceptance report: unsupported fields are rejected there and the worker\nfails at the acceptance handoff. Summarize work left undone in manualNotes.`,
];

/** JSON Schema for the implement/fix worker's checked acceptance handoff. */

result.output: 8:build workflow    scout → plan → implement (single writer, checked acceptance handoff)

# Factory (`/factory`)

A minimal, reliable software factory. `/factory <task>` launches a bounded, asynchronous software-delivery pipeline and keeps the parent Pi session as the orchestrator.

## Pipeline

```
build workflow    scout → plan → implement (single writer, checked acceptance handoff)
deterministic     human-authored validation commands from .pi/factory.json
review workflow   3 parallel fresh reviewers (correctness, tests, simplicity)
                  → at most ONE fix pass, only on structured "fix" verdicts
deterministic     the same trusted commands, rerun as final verification
```

- Scout, planner, and reviewers run with fresh context and read-only toolsets; the implement and fix workers are the only writers (one at a time).
- Every machine-consumed child result uses a structured output schema, and branching happens **only** on the structured verdict — never on reviewer prose.
- The plan or implement stage stopping with unresolved human-owned decisions pauses the factory (`needs_approval`) instead of proceeding.
- Malformed or missing structured output fails the stage closed (`needs_attention`), never onward as success.
- The fix loop is capped at exactly one pass by construction. Failed deterministic checks also stop the factory — no automated retry of side-effectful work.
- **No commit, push, merge, publish, deploy, or release is ever performed.**

Execution, lifecycle, missions, artifacts, status, resume, and Herdr integration are owned by the installed [pi-subagents](https://github.com/nicobailon/pi-subagents) package; this extension only validates the baseline, generates the two fixed workflows, correlates RPC replies, and runs the deterministic checks.

## Commands

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `/factory <task>` | Validate trust/baseline/config, then launch the build workflow asynchronously. |
| `/factory-status` | Show the latest run: swimlane waterfall, live workflow state, checks, reviewer disposition, decisions, errors. |

Baseline requirements: trusted project, inside a git work tree, clean working tree (unless `allowDirtyBaseline` is enabled), and `.pi/factory.json` present and valid.

## Configuration — `.pi/factory.json`

Human-authored project configuration. It is the **only** source of validation commands the factory will ever execute; commands proposed by model output are never run. Unknown fields and malformed values fail closed.

content.text:
Done — your assessment was correct, and the fix is implemented and committed.

## Verification of your diagnosis

**Confirmed, with one refinement.** The failure is a two-channel mismatch, not a schema conflict in the factory's own schema:

- The factory's `IMPL_SCHEMA` and worker prompts require `workLeftUndone` (and `decisionsRequiringApproval`) in the handoff, and workers run with `acceptance: { level: "checked" }` — `extensions/factory/src/workflow.ts`
- pi-subagents' `structured_output` tool validates **two** objects: `value` (against the factory schema — accepts the field) and `acceptanceReport` (against its own fixed set — `src/runs/shared/acceptance.js:586`, which has **no** `workLeftUndone`). At `subagent-prompt-runtime.js:605` an unknown field throws `Invalid structured output acceptance report: acceptanceReport.workLeftUndone: unsupported acceptance report field`, killing the worker exactly at the acceptance handoff
- Two adjacent traps in the same field set: `decisionsRequiringApproval` is also rejected, and the acceptance report's `commandsRun` entries require `{command, result: "passed"|"failed"|"not-run", summary}` — the factory's `{command, exitCode}` shape would fail there too

## Fix (in the factory, since pi-subagents is a pinned dependency)

**`extensions/factory/src/workflow.ts`**
- Added `ACCEPTANCE_REPORT_ALLOWED_FIELDS` — a documented mirror of pi-subagents' allowed field set
- Added shared `WORKER_REPORT_RULES` now used by both the implement and fix worker prompts, teaching the two-channel contract: the full handoff (including `workLeftUndone`, `decisionsRequiringApproval`) goes in `value`; the `acceptanceReport` may only contain the supported fields, with work left undone summarized under `manualNotes`, and report `commandsRun` using `result` instead of `exitCode`

**`tests/factory/workflow.test.ts`** — new regression tests pin the contract (value keeps `workLeftUndone`, report fields restricted, report command shape distinct). Full suite: **188 pass, 0 fail**.

**`extensions/factory/README.md`** — documented the two-channel reporting contract. Committed together as `e3f7c0a`.

The next `/factory` run should pass the acceptance handoff; the factory's own fail-closed handling (`handoffFromStructuredOutput`) still reads `workLeftUndone` from the value channel, so no state logic changed.
